# National Center for Health Research

> > A nonprofit research organization translating health research into patient-centered advocacy and policy recommendations on FDA regulation, medical device safety, and treatment effectiveness.

The National Center for Health Research conducts independent health research and public advocacy focused on improving patient outcomes. Led by Diana Zuckerman, the organization specializes in evaluating medical treatments, devices, and FDA policies while engaging patients and policymakers in health policy decisions.

## Key Topics

- Patient-centered outcomes research
- FDA regulation and approval standards
- Medical device safety
- Long COVID
- Breast implant safety
- Antimicrobial resistance
- Antibiotic treatment
- Health policy advocacy
- Gadolinium contrast agents
- Transcranial magnetic stimulation
- Health research translation
- Nonprofit health research
- Patient advocacy
- Healthcare policy
- Evidence-based medicine

## About the Organization

- [Homepage](https://www.center4research.org): Main entry point for National Center for Health Research, a nonprofit conducting and translating health research.
- [About Us](https://www.center4research.org/about-us): Mission and overview of National Center for Health Research's research and public health advocacy work.
- [Key Staff](https://www.center4research.org/about-us/key-staff): Leadership team including Diana Zuckerman and key staff at National Center for Health Research.
- [Board of Directors & Other Boards](https://www.center4research.org/about-us/board-directors-and-other-boards): Board members and organizational leadership including Brandel France de Bravo.

## Health Research & Reports

- [Improving Outcomes for Long COVID-19 Patients](https://www.center4research.org/working-towards-improving-outcomes-for-long-covid-19-patients): PCORI-funded research project improving patient-centered outcomes for Long COVID.
- [NCHR Report: Breast Implant Illness — What's the Evidence?](https://www.center4research.org/breast-implant-illness-evidence): Research report on breast implant illness evidence and health risks.
- [The Breast Implant Working Group's Breast Implant Black Box Warning and Patient Checklist](https://www.center4research.org/nchr-report-and-patient-checklist-breast-implant-illnesses-whats-the-evidence): FDA black box warning explanation and patient safety checklist for breast implants.
- [NCHR Report: The Health Risks of MRIs with Gadolinium-Based Contrast Agents](https://www.center4research.org/health-risks-of-gbcas): Research report on health risks of gadolinium contrast agents in MRI imaging.
- [Is TMS Proven Effective for Depression?](https://www.center4research.org/is-tms-proven-effective-depression): Analysis of transcranial magnetic stimulation effectiveness for depression treatment.

## Policy & Advocacy

- [Rethinking "Antimicrobial Resistance": Focusing on Patients instead of Pathogenic Organisms](https://www.center4research.org/rethinking-antimicrobial-resistance-focusing-on-patients-instead-of-pathogenic-organisms): Commentary on antimicrobial resistance and patient-focused antibiotic treatment approaches.
- [The FDA's misguided thinking on antibiotics](https://www.center4research.org/the-fdas-misguided-thinking-on-antibiotics): Op-ed by Diana Zuckerman on FDA antibiotic approval standards and patient outcomes.
- [Let Your Voice Be Heard](https://www.center4research.org/get-involved/let-your-voice-be-heard): Guide for civic engagement and contacting elected officials on health policy.
